note: A table is read and written only by the package that creates it (scripts/gates/table-owners.mjs). "shared" lists the tables several packages use on purpose; "same_name" lists the tables two packages each create, in different databases. Both are checked against the code in both directions: a package that uses a shared table and is not listed fails, a listed package that no longer uses it fails, a table that more than one package creates and is not under same_name fails, and a same_name entry that is not exactly the creating packages fails. "areas" lists directories inside a package that own their tables as a package would (Feed’s src/store); the rest of that package then counts as another owner, and an area that does not exist, holds a package.json, sits inside another area or no longer creates a table fails.

workspaces.reason: Two different tables in two different databases: the project catalog's workspaces (modules/projects, the catalog database) and the Alchemist's workspaces (plugins/native/alchemist, one studio.sqlite per project). Neither package reads the other's; specs/repository-anti-corruption spec.md section 9.5 item 9 keeps the names.

jobs.reason: Two different tables in two different databases: the Alchemist's jobs (plugins/native/alchemist, one studio.sqlite per project) and Images' jobs (plugins/native/images, images.db). Neither package reads the other's; specs/repository-anti-corruption spec.md section 9.5 item 9 keeps the names.

plugins/native/feed/src/store.reason: The Feed store owns the Feed tables it creates (items, materials, sources, Listener runs, signals and their events): the rest of the Feed package reads and writes them through the store's functions, so a Feed file outside src/store that names one of these tables in SQL fails (BL-802, which replaces the hand-written table list in scripts/check-package-boundaries.mjs).
